# Open Minds

> Open Minds is a Queensland-based mental health and disability support organization providing clinical care coordination, community living supports, and advocacy across multiple service locations.

Open Minds delivers integrated mental health services for adults and youth, alongside psychosocial disability support and community engagement programs. The organization operates across Queensland and New South Wales with a commitment to lived experience employment, First Nations reconciliation, and diversity inclusion.

## Key Topics

- Mental health services
- Disability support
- Clinical care coordination
- Community living supports
- Psychosocial disability
- Youth services
- Lived experience
- Suicide prevention
- Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander engagement
- LGBTIQA+ inclusion
- NDIS referrals
- Queensland Mental Health Awards
- Reconciliation Action Plan
- Community outreach
- Peer work

## Core Services

- [What We Do](https://openminds.org.au/what-we-do): Open Minds services overview: adult, youth mental health, and disability
- [Clinical Care Coordination](https://openminds.org.au/services/adult-mental-health/clinical-care-coordination): Clinical care coordination for severe mental illness via Better Connect
- [Community Living Supports](https://openminds.org.au/services/adult-mental-health/community-lifestyle-support): Community living supports for complex mental health in NSW and Queensland
